claims.assertion: Yazhi says some astral combatants are humans entering the astral artificially through immersion pods.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes these recent artificial entrants from older astral fighting described as angels against demons.

claims.assertion: Yazhi calls flat-Earth belief a disinformation agenda meant to distract awakened people from extraterrestrial topics.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She affirms it can also discredit extraterrestrial claims.

claims.assertion: Yazhi interprets the biblical dome as the Van Allen belts rather than a solid cover over Earth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as an interpretation of biblical imagery.
